svg.title: Nine groups in the portable workflow layer
svg.desc: Nine groups surround the portable-workflow layer. Research finds evidence and tests ideas. PhD and Career plans the degree and next step. Study and Productivity supports learning and practice. Teaching prepares classes and assessments. Engineering designs and checks builds. System Builder shapes the vault. Janitor tidies folders and links. Capture saves decisions and next steps. Writing Profiles guide writing style.
svg.metadata: Eight embedded PNGs retain their exact approved source bytes and embedded provenance. Source names: system_research.png, system_study.png, system_teaching.png, system_engineering.png, system_builder.png, system_janitor.png, system_capture.png, system_writing.png. Graduation cap and ring shapes are new native SVG draft artwork.
